import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Save submission directory if it doesn't exist
import os

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Prepare features
train_id = train["Id"].copy()
test_id = test["Id"].copy()

train_features = train.drop(["Id", "Cover_Type"], axis=1).copy()
test_features = test.drop("Id", axis=1).copy()
train_target = train["Cover_Type"].copy()

# Split training data into train and validation (hold-out)
train_X, val_X, train_y, val_y = train_test_split(
    train_features, train_target, test_size=0.15, random_state=42
)

# Train Random Forest model with improved parameters
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=None,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    min_samples_leaf=2,
)
rf_model.fit(train_X, train_y)

# Train Gradient Boosting model
gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=300,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=42,
)
gb_model.fit(train_X, train_y)

# Evaluate on validation set
rf_val_predictions = rf_model.predict(val_X)
gb_val_predictions = gb_model.predict(val_X)

# Ensemble: use weighted average of predictions (majority voting)
rf_preds = np.argmax(rf_val_predictions, axis=1)
gb_preds = np.argmax(gb_val_predictions, axis=1)
ensemble_preds = np.where(rf_preds == gb_preds, rf_preds, gb_preds)  # Majority vote

val_accuracy = accuracy_score(val_y, ensemble_preds)
print(f"Ensemble Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test data
rf_test_preds = rf_model.predict(test_features)
gb_test_preds = gb_model.predict(test_features)
ensemble_test_preds = np.where(
    rf_test_preds == gb_test_preds, rf_test_preds, gb_test_preds
)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_id.values, "Cover_Type": ensemble_test_preds.astype(int)}
)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Test set size: {len(test)} rows")
print(f"Submission file size: {len(submission)} rows")
